messages:
nate: seeing an odd p95 tail jump in the canary after enabling the new tokenizer cache. p95 ~380ms -> ~760ms on some hosts. No 5xxs reported yet. deploy-bot queued autorevert (low conf).

deploy-bot: ALERT: canary p95 threshold breached. Suggested: autorevert -> v5.0.3 (confidence 0.46). Autorevert in 70s unless suppressed. Possible causes: cache shard imbalance, allocator/mem-copy increase.

mira: hold autorevert. We need span trace correlation across the new tokenizer path before we lose the signal.

ops-jo: copying traces now: `rdwctl grab --scope canary --kinds traces,cache-metrics --since 7m --out s3://rdw-dumps/1761112222-tokenizer-snap.tar.gz`

nate: pinning canary to previous stable: `releases pin --cohort canary --to v5.0.2 --reason "tokenizer cache tail; manual hold"`  applied. Posting a short note to #customer-notices: "Investigating internal canary perf regression; no customer impact seen."

mira: propose rollback criteria: (1) if hotpatch unset of `tokenizer_cache_shard_v2` reduces p95 < 220ms within 10m -> resume; (2) immediate rollback to v5.0.1 if client error-rate delta > 0.35% or p95 stays >500ms for 12m. Also log who suppressed autorevert in release notes.

deploy-bot: NOTE: autorevert suppressed by operator hold (actor: mira). To enable: `deploybot enable-autorevert --actor system`

ops-jo: upload done: s3://rdw-dumps/1761112222-tokenizer-snap.tar.gz. Quick flamegraphs show repeated memcpy in tokenizer codec path and higher lock contention on cache shards. Suspect `tokenizer_cache_shard_v2`.

mira: approve hotpatch unset. Ops, please remove the flag and rolling-restart the canary subset (wait 40s between nodes).

ops-jo: running: `opsctl patch config --unset tokenizer_cache_shard_v2 --reason "canary perf regression"`
ops-jo: patch applied. restarting canary-1 ... ok; canary-2 ... ok; canary-3 ... ok

deploy-bot: MONITOR: post-hotpatch p95 fell from ~760ms -> ~160ms across canary in 3m. Autorevert remains suppressed per operator hold.

cs-lena: prepping a proactive blurb for customers in case we need to escalate; tagging legal if we issue a timed maintenance.

nate: recommendation: unpin and resume a slow rollout: 5% increments every 6m up to 20%, keep autorevert suppressed for 50m to avoid flip-flop. Create rollback ticket if metrics regress.

mira: assigning postmortem owner @mira, draft due EOD. Include root cause (shard lock + memcpy), decision to hotpatch, and followups (tune shard sizing + add regression test).

ops-jo: resuming rollout now: `releases resume --cohort canary --to v5.0.4 --increment 5%/6m --max 20%`  done.

deploy-bot: INFO: rollout resumed under manual supervision. Closing thread after postmortem link posted.
